# INLA Modelling Functions

Functions defined in `R/inla-modeling.R`.

---

## `fit_weighted_inla_model()`

Fits a Besag-proper CAR spatial model via INLA. When `spatial_term = "besagproper_rbf"`,
the spatial precision matrix is additionally weighted by an RBF/Laplacian kernel over
pairwise Gower distance between adjacent links' road attributes.

```r
fit_weighted_inla_model(
  data,
  adjacency_matrix,
  spatial_term          = "besagproper_rbf",
  similarity_covariates = NULL,
  ordinal_levels        = list(),
  distance_type         = "gower",
  weight_fn             = "laplacian",
  fixed_effects         = ~ 1,
  iid_effects           = "roadSystem",
  heavy_vehicle         = FALSE,
  family                = "gaussian",
  extraconstr           = NULL,
  verbose               = FALSE
)
```

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `data` | data frame | Prepared traffic links; must have `id` and the response column (`aadt`/`heavyAadt`) |
| `adjacency_matrix` | sparse matrix | Square n×n adjacency of traffic links |
| `spatial_term` | character | `"besagproper_rbf"` (default) or `"besagproper"` |
| `similarity_covariates` | character vector | Column names used to compute Gower distances; uses defaults if `NULL` |
| `ordinal_levels` | named list | Ordered factor levels for ordinal covariates |
| `distance_type` | character | `"gower"` or `"gower_squared"` |
| `weight_fn` | character | `"laplacian"`, `"gaussian"`, or `"linear"` |
| `fixed_effects` | formula | Fixed-effects formula passed to INLA |
| `iid_effects` | character vector or NULL | Column(s) for IID random effects |
| `heavy_vehicle` | logical | If `TRUE`, model `heavyAadt` instead of `aadt` |
| `family` | character | `"gaussian"`, `"poisson"`, or `"nbinomial"` |
| `extraconstr` | list or NULL | Flow-conservation constraint `list(A = <m x n matrix>, e = <m vector>)` |
| `verbose` | logical | INLA verbosity |

### Returns

A `weighted_inla_traffic_model` object (list): `predictions` (data frame with `id`,
`inla_pred[_heavy]`, `inla_sd[_heavy]`), `model_summary`, `spatial_hyperpar` (natural-scale
`tau`/`d`/`sigma`), `distances` (edge Gower distances — feed into
`create_covariance_and_precision_matrix()`), `inla_model`, `formula`, `family`,
`spatial_term`, `similarity_covariates`, `ordinal_levels`.

## `kfold_cv_inla()`

k-fold cross-validation for `fit_weighted_inla_model()`. Evaluates out-of-sample predictive
performance by repeatedly holding out folds of measured links.

```r
kfold_cv_inla(
  data,
  adjacency_matrix,
  k                     = 5,
  seed                  = 42,
  fixed_effects         = ~ 1,
  spatial_term          = "besagproper_rbf",
  similarity_covariates = NULL,
  ordinal_levels        = list(),
  iid_effects           = "roadSystem",
  family                = "gaussian",
  heavy_vehicle         = FALSE,
  verbose               = FALSE,
  weight_fn             = "laplacian",
  distance_type         = "gower"
)
```

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `k` | integer | Number of CV folds |
| `seed` | integer | RNG seed for fold assignment |

All other parameters are passed directly to `fit_weighted_inla_model()`.

### Returns

An `inla_kfold_cv` object (list): `fold_metrics` (RMSE/MAE/MAPE/MALE per fold),
`summary_metrics` (mean ± SD across folds), `oof_predictions` (one row per held-out link),
`k`, `seed`, `family`, `spatial_term`.

---

## `select_similarity_covariates()`

Greedy forward selection of `similarity_covariates` for the RBF kernel: starts from an
empty set and repeatedly adds the candidate that most reduces mean CV-RMSE, using
`kfold_cv_inla()` internally. Ordinal levels are automatically subsetted to the active
covariate set at each step. Stops when no addition improves performance.

```r
select_similarity_covariates(
  data,
  adjacency_matrix,
  candidate_covariates = c("maxLanes", "minLanes", "highestSpeedLimit",
                            "lowestSpeedLimit", "isRamp", "roadCategory",
                            "functionClass", "functionalRoadClass",
                            "roadSystem", "lastYearAadt_logAadt"),
  ordinal_levels        = list(
    functionalRoadClass = as.character(c(7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1, 0)),
    roadCategory        = c("KOMMUNAL_VEG", "FYLKESVEG", "RIKSVEG", "EUROPAVEG"),
    functionClass       = c("unknown", "E", "D", "C", "B", "A"),
    highestSpeedLimit   = c("unknown", "30", "40", "50", "60", "70", "80", "90", "100", "110"),
    lowestSpeedLimit    = c("unknown", "20", "30", "40", "50", "60", "70", "80", "90", "100")
  ),
  fixed_effects = ~ functionalRoadClass:maxLanes +
    functionalRoadClass:roadCategory +
    minLanes:roadCategory + functionalRoadClass +
    maxLanes + roadCategory +
    hasOnlyPublicTransportLanes +
    functionalRoadClass * isRamp +
    lastYearAadt_logAadt,
  iid_effects   = "roadSystem",
  family        = "nbinomial",
  distance_type = "gower",
  weight_fn     = "laplacian",
  k             = 10,
  seed          = 420,
  verbose       = FALSE
)
```

### Returns

A list (invisible): `best_covariates` (character vector to pass as `similarity_covariates`
in `fit_weighted_inla_model()`), `best_ordinal_levels`, `best_male`, `selection_history`
(data frame logging each forward-selection step).
